narrative_goal: Trace the historical reversal in the share of African Americans living in the South, which fell from 0.92 in 1950 to 0.26 in 1990 before rising to 0.51 by 2010.
intent_en: Trace the share of African Americans living in the South over the period from 1950 to 2010 to identify the direction and turning points in that share.
